Beige Book - March 2023

Federal Reserve Bank of Boston

Summary of Economic Activity

Business activity was about flat, and contacts voiced uncertainty about the outlook.

Banking contacts described deposit outflows and elevated risks after the recent bank failures.

Labor Markets

Employment was steady, but hiring slowed amid uncertain demand.

Some firms announced layoffs, and workers voiced concerns about job security.

Wage growth was subdued as labor demand softened.

Prices

Prices increased modestly.

Restaurant contacts flagged volatile food costs.
